title: pyrostegia tecomiflora
intro: Pyrostegia tecomiflora, commonly known as the Flaming Trumpet Creeper or Orange Trumpet Vine, is a flowering evergreen vine native to Brazil and Argentina. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Pyrostegia tecomiflora include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
